paragraphs.source_en: Ten years had passed since her former husband, Azai Nagamasa, had taken his own life at Odani Castle in Ōmi. Even so, those bygone days, faded like a dream, seemed to have happened only yesterday; Oichi could neither forget them nor free herself from their hold. She had meant to become a lay nun and live out her days with her three daughters, yet instead she had once again become a wife—this time to Shibata Shuri-no-suke Katsuie. To her, it always seemed like a nightmare.
